description_en: Adds a live-to-VOD recording configuration to save recorded content to the VOD media library
description_zh: 增加直播录制转点播配置，将录制内容保存到点播媒资库
kebab_example: aliyun live add-live-record-vod-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name testName --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddLiveRecordVodConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ingest domain.
Make sure that ApsaraVideo VOD is activated in the same region as the live center of the streaming domain
parameters.help_zh:
主播流域名。
请先确认与此播放域名直播中心相同区域的点播已开通服务
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. You can view the application name on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 播流所属应用名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The stream name. You can view the stream name on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
<notice>This parameter is invalid and can be left empty when you use the format-specific configuration feature, which means the RecordFormat parameter is specified.</notice>
The ID of the VOD transcoding template group used to transcode the recorded video in ApsaraVideo VOD
parameters.help_zh:
<notice>当使用按格式配置功能，即传入RecordFormat参数时，此参数无效，可不传。></notice>
对录制后的视频在点播服务中进行一次转码，所使用的点播转码模板组ID
parameters.name: vod_transcode_group_id

parameters.help_en: The recording length of an epoch. Unit: seconds. Default value: 3600. Valid values: 300 to 21600
parameters.help_zh: 周期录制时长。单位：秒。默认值为3600，取值范围：300~21600
parameters.name: cycle_duration

parameters.help_en:
<notice>This parameter is invalid and can be left empty when you use the format-specific configuration feature, which means the RecordFormat parameter is specified.</notice>
Specifies whether to automatically merge multiple recording period files into a single recording file after live recording ends.

A value of ON enables automatic merging. If you set this parameter to ON, you must also specify the ComposeVodTranscodeGroupId request parameter. If you leave this parameter empty, automatic merging is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
<notice>当使用按格式配置功能，即传入RecordFormat参数时，此参数无效，可不传。></notice>
在直播录制结束后自动将多个录制周期文件合并成一个录制文件。

设置为ON表示开启自动合并，且必须同时设置请求参数ComposeVodTranscodeGroupId。不传入参数值表示关闭自动合并
parameters.name: auto_compose

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VOD application workspace. You can obtain the ID from the ApsaraVideo VOD console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454873.html. This parameter is not required if the application workspace feature is not enabled
parameters.help_zh: 点播应用空间ID，通过点播控制台或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454873.html获取。未开启应用空间时无需填写
parameters.name: space_id

parameters.help_en:
<notice>This parameter is invalid and can be left empty when you use the format-specific configuration feature, which means the RecordFormat parameter is specified.</notice>
The ID of the VOD transcoding template group used to transcode the newly merged video in ApsaraVideo VOD. This parameter is required when AutoCompose is set to ON
parameters.help_zh:
<notice>当使用按格式配置功能，即传入RecordFormat参数时，此参数无效，可不传></notice>
对自动合成出来的新视频在点播服务中进行一次转码，所使用的点播转码模板组ID。当AutoCompose为ON时，本参数必填
parameters.name: compose_vod_transcode_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The recording trigger method. Valid values:
 
0 (default): Automatic recording.

1: On-demand recording by using HTTP callbacks.

2: On-demand recording by parsing stream ingest parameters.

7: Manual recording. By default, recording is not started. You can call the RealTimeRecordCommand operation to manually start or stop recording
parameters.help_zh:
录制触发方式，取值：
 
0（默认值）：自动录制。

1：按需录制，通过 HTTP 回调方式。

2：按需录制，通过解析推流参数。

7：手动录制，默认不录制，可以通过 RealTimeRecordCommand 接口手动控制录制开启或停止
parameters.name: on_demand

parameters.help_en:
The content to be recorded. Valid values:

raw (default): Records the source stream.

transcode: Records the transcoded stream.

To record both the source stream and the transcoded stream, specify both values and separate them with a comma (,), such as raw,transcode.
If the recorded content includes transcode, you must specify at least one transcoding template in TranscodeTemplates
parameters.help_zh:
录制内容。取值：

raw(默认值)：录制源流

transcode：录制转码流

如需同时录制源流和转码流，请将两个取值同时传入,以","分隔，如raw,transcode
录制内容包含transcode时，TranscodeTemplates至少传入一个转码模版
parameters.name: record_content

parameters.help_en: The stream interruption splicing duration. If a live stream interruption lasts longer than the specified splicing duration, a new file is generated. Valid values: 15 to 21600. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 断流拼接时长。 直播断流时长超过设定的拼接时长后，将会生成新文件，断流拼接时长支持 15~21600 秒
parameters.name: delay_time

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically merge multiple recording period files into a single recording file after live recording ends. Valid values:

ON: Enables automatic merging.

OFF: Disables automatic merging
fields.help_zh:
在直播录制结束后自动将多个录制周期文件合并成一个录制文件。取值：

ON：开启自动合并

OFF：关闭自动合并
fields.name: auto_compose

fields.help_en:
The recording format. Valid values:
m3u8
flv
mp4
fields.help_zh:
录制格式。取值：
m3u8
flv
mp4
fields.name: format

fields.help_en:
The video processing method. Valid values:

transcode: Uses a transcoding template group to process the video.

workflow: Uses a workflow to process the video
fields.help_zh:
视频处理方式。取值：

transcode：使用转码模版组处理视频

workflow：使用工作流处理视频
fields.name: process_method

fields.help_en:
The ID of the transcoding template group or workflow template used for video processing.

The ID specified here must correspond to the video processing method specified in ProcessMethod. For example, if ProcessMethod is set to transcode, you must specify the ID of a transcoding template group here
fields.help_zh:
视频处理转码模版组ID或工作流模版ID。取值：

此处传入的ID必须与ProcessMethod传入的视频处理方式对应，即ProcessMethod传入transcode，此处应使用转码模版组ID
fields.name: process_template_id

fields.help_en:
The segment length. Unit: seconds.

This parameter is valid only when RecordFormat.N.Format is set to m3u8.

Default value: 30. Valid values: 5 to 30
fields.help_zh:
单个切片时长。单位：秒。

仅当RecordFormat.N.Format（格式）设为m3u8时，本参数有效。

不填则默认为30秒。取值范围：5s~30s
fields.name: slice_duration

fields.help_en:
The video processing source. Valid values:

origin (default): Processes the source video.

compose: Processes the merged video.

For simultaneous processing of the source video and the merged video, specify both values and separate them with a comma (,), such as origin,compose
fields.help_zh:
视频处理源。取值：

origin(默认值)：处理源视频

compose：处理合并后视频

如需同时处理源视频和合并后视频，请将两个取值同时传入,以","分隔，如origin,compose
fields.name: video_process

parameters.help_en: The list of recording parameters configured by format
parameters.help_zh: 按格式配置录制参数列表
parameters.name: record_format

parameters.help_en: The transcoding template groups used for recording transcoded streams
parameters.help_zh: 转码流录制的转码模板组
parameters.name: transcode_templates
